big_idea: MULTISTEP MOVEMENT uses STEPS plus QUARTER (90°) or HALF (180°) turns.
learning_intention: We are learning to give and follow movement directions with quarter and half turns.
student_learning_goal: I can give and follow movement directions with turns.
success_criteria: I can MOVE a marker step by step.
I can TURN a quarter (90°) or half (180°).
lesson_specific_materials: OPTIONAL: Trekker Tig and Compass Coco — if available; otherwise teacher voices both characters in two distinct voices, or substitutes two stuffed animals / paper-bag puppets / pictures on the anchor poster. Activity is unaffected.

minds_on.hook: Compass Coco: I'll move a marker on the map. 3 steps + quarter turn + 2 steps = treasure! Tig opens: 'Quarter is 90, half is 180 — that's ROTATION!'
minds_on.teacher_script:
Bring children to the carpet. Compass Coco the Cat puppet with compass. 'Geometers — today we MAP IT and MOVE IT.'

Define. 'A QUARTER TURN is 90 degrees — like the corner of a square. A HALF TURN is 180 degrees — like facing the opposite way.'

Demo with hand or pointer. 'Stand. Face front. Quarter turn right — now face right. Another quarter — now face back. Another quarter — now face left. 4 quarters = full circle.'

'Half turn from front = back. ONE step.'

'Compass Coco says — turns and steps WORK TOGETHER.'

Demo on the map. 'I'll start at A. Move 3 steps right. QUARTER TURN. Move 2 steps. I'm at TREASURE!'

Now show 3 sample direction cards:
- 'Move 4 right + quarter turn + 2 forward.'
- 'Move 2 forward + half turn + 3 forward.'
- 'Move 1 right + quarter turn + 1 forward + quarter turn + 2 right.'

Demonstrate each with the marker. Children echo turns by physically turning at their seats.

'Compass Coco says — multistep directions are RECIPES for movement!'

Now each pair gets a Map Grid + 4 Robot Cards. They follow each card and check landing spots.

'Compass Coco says — every step + turn matters. Check each one!'

steps.instruction: Hand out Map Grids + 4 direction cards. Pairs follow each.
Pairs CREATE 2 multistep directions and trade.
Stretch: write a 5-step direction with 2 turns.
Help with quarter vs half turn — body demo.

STRATEGY COMPARE: Pose ONE start/treasure pair on anchor map. Two pairs share — Pair A 'rotate first, walk second'; Pair B 'walk first, rotate second'. Class debates which is more reliable. Cite Battista (2007) on spatial reasoning.
steps.teacher_prompt: Tig: 'Same destination, different orders. The MATH says: rotate, then walk, then rotate again as needed.'

differentiation.for_movement_learners: Walk a tape grid on floor.

formative_check.what_to_look_for: Five signals: steps; turns; gives; follows; consistency.

discussion_prompts: How do steps and turns combine?
Give a 3-step direction to your partner.
consolidation.exit_routine: Tig + Coco rotation refrain — 'Quarter is 90, half is 180 — that's ROTATION!' (3x). Each child shows one rotation with amount + direction stated.

expanded_walkthrough.title: When the child confuses QUARTER and HALF turn — repairing the turn-size trap at Grade 3
expanded_walkthrough.rationale:
On map-following with quarter/half turns, the trap is rotation-amount confusion: child does a half when the card says quarter. Battista (2007) on spatial reasoning + Clements & Battista on rotation understanding frame this.

Yesterday Lesson 3 worked on congruence. Today: map it + move it. Lesson 5 capstones.
expanded_walkthrough.setup: Movement activity. Child does a half turn when card says quarter.
expanded_walkthrough.teacher_script:
Crouch. 'Compass Coco asks — show me with your body: quarter turn.'

Probe. 'Quarter = 90 degrees. From front, you face RIGHT (or LEFT). NOT all the way around.'

Generalise. 'Compass Coco says — QUARTER = corner of a square (90°). HALF = facing OPPOSITE (180°).'

If still confused: 4 quarters = 1 full. 2 halves = 1 full. So QUARTER is half of HALF.
common_misconceptions: Turns are all the same. (Repair: 90 vs 180.)
Half = quarter twice. (Repair: yes, that's the relation.)
recovery_moves: DIAGNOSTIC A — child does half when card says quarter: anchor 'quarter = 90°' with body demo; child re-rotates physical body.
DIAGNOSTIC B — child does quarter but wrong direction: drill 'left vs right' with arm demo first.
DIAGNOSTIC C — child rotates correctly but cannot articulate: force 'I turned ___ degrees in the ___ direction.'

parts_outline.task: Follow 3 multistep directions on a map grid.
Identify quarter vs half turn for 4 turns.
